summary: std::string_view (C++17) is a non-owning view that refers to a constant contiguous sequence of characters. It provides a lightweight way to pass string data without copying, ideal for function parameters and string processing.
cpp17_notes: std::string_view is new in C++17. It satisfies borrowed_range and view concepts. Since C++20, iterator and const_iterator are the same type. Since C++23, it is TriviallyCopyable. C++23 adds contains().
audio_thread_notes: std::string_view is SAFE for real-time audio. It does not allocate - it only stores a pointer and size. Use it to pass string data without copying. WARNING: Ensure the underlying string outlives the view. Never create a string_view from a temporary std::string.
